description: Reads or changes who drives a connected remote browser: `agent` (your CDP connection) or `human` (a person in its live view, see spicrawl_browser_live_view). `status` reads it: poll it after sending a live-view link, and continue once `controller` is `agent` again. `takeover` hands control to the person before they ask (your input and navigation then fail with error -32001); `release` takes it back. The person can also take and give back control from the live view themselves.

action.description: `status` (default) reads; `takeover` gives control to the person; `release` gives it back to the agent.

session_id.description: The remote browser session, as `session_id` from spicrawl_browser_connect_url. It exists while that connection is open.

name: spicrawl_browser_control

controller.description: Who drives the browser: `agent` (your CDP connection) or `human` (a person in the live view).

expires_at.description: When the session ends at the latest, RFC 3339 UTC.

title: Who controls a remote browser
